# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest release of pocket-portfolio-tracker is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

I take the security of pocket-portfolio-tracker seriously. If you find a security
vulnerability, please do NOT open a public issue. Instead, report it privately.

**Contact:** Open a private security advisory on GitHub
([github.com/s3ntin3l8/pocket-portfolio-tracker/security/advisories/new](https://github.com/s3ntin3l8/pocket-portfolio-tracker/security/advisories/new))
or message [@s3ntin3l8](https://github.com/s3ntin3l8) directly.

I will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a timeline for a fix within
7 days. Once a fix is verified, a new version will be released and credit will be given
in the changelog if desired.

## Scope

This policy covers the pocket-portfolio-tracker monorepo (API, web, and vendored
dependencies). Third-party broker integrations (Trade Republic, Interactive Brokers) are
covered by their own security policies; vulnerabilities that originate in those services
should be reported to them directly.
